about_the_game:
Trapped in an endless nightmare, Ayumi wakes in a cursed library where reality bends and time loops without end. Each cycle drags her deeper into the mystery, forcing her to confront unsettling truths hidden within the stacks.

Navigate the library’s eerie corridors, solve challenging puzzles, and piece together the fragments of Ayumi’s past. But with every loop, the sense of dread grows stronger, and escape feels further away.

Features:

  • Psychological horror set in a looping-world environment

  • Atmospheric environments inspired by Japanese urban legends

  • Carefully crafted puzzles that test observation and logic

  • Dynamic scares that respond to player choices and actions

  • Multiple endings based on your decisions

Will you uncover the truth and escape the cycle, or remain forever trapped within the library’s walls?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 4570 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 5700k or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A haunting psychological horror set between school life and a cursed library. Relive the same days. Search for answers. Try to wake up.
